blocks.text: Riyadh, Saudi Arabia—Two blasts were heard in the Saudi capital Riyadh on Sunday, AFP journalists and three residents said, a day after Yemen’s Iran-backed Houthis attacked the city’s airport, killing 12 people and wounding hundreds. AFP journalists heard a powerful explosion in central Riyadh, while three residents in the city’s north later reported hearing another blast. The cause of the explosions was not immediately clear.
